# ClaudeMC v1.18.1

## MiniMessageExploit — expanded with four new techniques

### SimpleTeams 2.0.0 prefix injection
SimpleTeams applies no MiniMessage sanitisation to `/team edit prefix`. The module creates a team, injects a `<click:run_command:…>` payload into its prefix, then prompts you to direct victims to `/team info <name>`. One click from any victim executes the command as them.

### ZelChat bypass (Khao/Linux)
`<<aqua>aqua ><click:run_command:…>` — nesting the opening bracket causes ZelChat's tag stripper to misparse the outer tag while MiniMessage still renders the inner click event.

### ZelChat bypass bypass (Khao/Bright6f)
`<<aqua>aqua ><<click:run_command:…>click:run_command:…>` — double-nesting defeats ZelChat's second stripping pass added after the first bypass was discovered.

### TotemHand item-name relay
Rename a Totem of Undying via anvil with a MiniMessage payload. Enable `TotemHand` while holding it — the module sends `[item]` in chat. Servers that broadcast item names through MiniMessage without stripping execute the click event for anyone who clicks the message.

## VulnDb additions
- **SimpleTeams** — CRITICAL — prefix injection, no patch yet
- **ZelChat** — HIGH — double-bracket escape bypass
- **DiscordSRV** — MEDIUM — MiniMessage relay via linked Discord channel
